requirement.normalizedRequirement: The Ice Class Regulations of 2002 (20.9.2002 No. 5/30/2002), issued by the Finnish Maritime Administration, as amended, apply to ships the keels of which have been laid or which have been at a similar stage of construction on or after 1 September 2003 but which have been contracted for construction before 1 January 2010.
